items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Joe Davis asked me if I could get Coleman... I called Coleman. I said, 'Coleman, would you do a recording date with me?'... And one thing I give Joe Davis credit for, he could give a name to a tune.
